snippet.title: Ys vs. Trails in the Sky: Alternative Saga - Release Date Trailer (Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5, PC)
snippet.description:
Two worlds collide! Adol & Estelle must face the threat of Dragon King Galsis as allies and rivals unite in Ys vs. Trails in the Sky: Alternative Saga, a crossover RPG/fighting hybrid coming to Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5 and PC on October 10th, 2025!

Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/ys-vs-trails-in-the-sky-alternative-saga-switch/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10010925
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1794880/Ys_vs_Trails_in_the_Sky_Alternative_Saga/
GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/ys_vs_trails_in_the_sky_alternative_saga
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/ys-vs-trails-in-the-sky-alternative-saga-896f4d
